test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

I __have withdraw__ money from the bank.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Have withdrawn.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As the sentence is in the present perfect tense.
 
• The sentence structure for the present perfect tense is has//have+ [past participle]. 
 
• So, the verb '**withdraw' **should be replaced with '**withdrawn'**.
 
• Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is: *I have **withdrawn **money from the bank.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Present Perfect Tense:

 
• The **present perfect tense **refers to an action or state that either occurred at an indefinite time in the past

 
 
• We **have **talked before.
